data.title: 矢来美羽 · 雨后的街角
data.description: 雨刚停，街角的积水映出招牌。美羽收起伞，回头确认路口已经恢复通行。
data.action: holding a closed umbrella and looking back at the crossing
data.promptProse: Standing on a rain-washed street corner in the evening, Miu holds a closed umbrella at her side, looking back over her shoulder with an amused, sparkling smile. Storefront signs and streetlights reflect in sidewalk puddles under the clearing twilight sky.
